name: Sky Falcon
purpose: Exact-source-pinned full visible head-tab vertex ownership diagnosis, including both sides. No production asset/tracker edits.
status: FROZEN-DIAGNOSIS-FOR-REPAIR; source visual deformation remains confirmed on first-visible tab.

battleComparison.note: Battle LOD was fully head-weighted in the prior exact-pair diagnosis; this addition only freezes the opposite source tab ownership.

originalDiagnosis.diagnosis: Complete bind-pose surface selection of the visible white side tab, its lower rim, and black attachment root confirms real animation deformation in the current source GLB. The selected 188 source vertices include 66 head-only vertices and 122 vertices blended with wing_midL (4.3–36.9%) and wing_upperL (1.2–10.6%). Relative to the head joint, source selected-vertex drift reaches 0.1196 model units; at attack 0.24 the selected surface compresses a sampled edge to 5.79% of bind length and expands another to 224.85%; at attack 0.48 expansion reaches 278.24%; hit-react 0.12 reaches 291.83%. Entrance also deforms the surface, with 5.58% maximum head-local vertex drift and a sampled edge shrinking to 10.66% at 0.24. The matching battle surface (81 selected vertices) is fully weighted to head and remains rigid to numerical tolerance. This is a source-LOD skinning defect, not a cloth simulation or style-only ambiguity. Semantics of feather vs cheek remain secondary: the visible head-side surface’s original shape is pulled by wing bones in source, while current battle LOD has already flattened those weights to head, explaining stage divergence.

firstSideMetrics.method: From exact-current source/battle native bind-pose rendered side silhouette, raycast a bounded polygon covering the complete broad white tab, lower rim, and its black root; collect every visible triangle/vertex (no torso or neck region). Track all selected vertices in the head joint’s local coordinate frame at eight normalized phases for attack, idle_hitreact1, and entrance. Edge ratios compare indexed edges from the selected visible triangles against imported default bind pose; ratio edges use baseline length >=0.002 units.

selectionMethod.renderer: In-memory bundle of current src/pet-shape-audit.ts; exact GLB routed from local bytes; native production diffuse materials; bind pose; side-specific orthographic-like camera; screen polygon ray hits, then triangle vertices.
selectionMethod.selectionIncludes: Entire visible cheek/tab lobe plus attachment-side dark root and lower rim; excludes eye, neck/throat, torso, and actual wing surface.

oppositeStage.camera: head-other-side; camera direction -X; personally inspected; not assumed mirrored

vertexUnion.positions: headLocalBindPosition is the bind-pose point transformed into head-joint local space; geometryPosition is the original source mesh attribute position.

oppositeSideFinding.interpretation: The personally viewed opposite-side overlay covers its own white cheek/tab visible lobe, root, and lower rim. Unlike the first side, all 46 selected source vertices are 100% head-weighted; no wing-weighted vertices were found in this selected region. The visible geometry is side-specific and differs in extent from the first side, so it was selected from its own image rather than mirrored.

oppositeSide.otherHeadSideVerticesOutsideTab: Not selected or asserted; this diagnosis is limited to the two visually identified cheek/tab surface regions.

repairScopeGuidance: Rigid-bind both complete head tabs (all IDs in this source union) to head while preserving actual wing geometry, source texture, and remaining original sculpt. Then run source+battle pair regressions and full source visual review against the new exact hashes.
limitations: Original source animation deformation and first-side wing-weight contamination remain confirmed by the cited full phase metrics.
Opposite side has no selected wing contamination; this does not clear the first-side defect.
The report excludes head-side vertices outside the two visible cheek/tab regions.
